mentions.name: Crucial Exams
mentions.description: This platform helps people prepare for IT certifications like CompTIA, AWS, and Microsoft/Azure by offering realistic practice tests and study tools. It also partners with educators and universities, which offer it to their students and receive dashboards to review student progress and identify where students are struggling.
mentions.audience: People preparing for IT certifications (CompTIA, AWS, Microsoft/Azure), as well as educators and universities who use it with their students
